coefficient_meaning: First12 are the actual coefficients of a^i z^j in permanent(J+aH+zV)-24. Last is zz*H23-1. No primitive rescaling in this .ms input.
export_format: Singular stdout markers COFACTOR_INDEX then integer1..13, COFACTOR_POLYNOMIAL then long explicit polynomial; short=0. Planned independent sparse QQ JSON after success.
simplification: Generator8 equals generator1 squared divided by16, so its contribution can be absorbed into cofactor1 before Lean generation.
